description: This file defines the interface for a PUCCH detector class, including configuration structures for Formats 0 and 1, detection result structures, and virtual detection methods. It is part of a 3GPP-based radio communication system implementation.

classes.name: pucch_detector
classes.description: Interface class for detecting PUCCH transmissions for Formats 0 and 1, providing configuration and detection result structures.

methods.name: detect (Format 0)
methods.description: Detects a PUCCH Format 0 transmission given a resource grid and configuration.

methods.name: detect (Format 1)
methods.description: Detects multiplexed PUCCH Format 1 transmissions given a resource grid, configuration, and multiplexing map.
